name: @geo-content-os/api
description: GEO Content OS — NestJS 11 + FastifyAdapter API

scripts.build:runtime-dependencies: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/security build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/observability build
scripts.build:test-dependencies: pnpm build:runtime-dependencies && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/testkit build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-outbox-relay build
scripts.test:security: pnpm build:test-dependencies && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/common/security && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts test/integration/security-rate-limit.integration.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:test-dependencies && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --pretty false
